objective.text: File whole-lifecycle claims for as many claim-ready decided orders as the measured route allows: the remaining claim-ready YES pool (about 190), a 30-order probe of the best Larrey-gated claim-ready NO orders (the NO stratum is below Augur's 0.2 per dollar floor), then a 300-order probe of status assignment for undecided orders, using Gilbreth's measured cuts (correction-route pre-screen, held-source registration at prep, pooled review sets of 7 or more, FR-capture later events). Scripted Claude coordination in this cloud session; Sonnet producers; two blind Opus arms; claims file only when both uphold.

premortem.failure: The cloud container (2 CPUs, about 3 GB free disk) stalls or fills while many packets run kit apply and batch-check
premortem.guard: at most 6 producer lanes at once; completion receipts over 50 MB gzipped at each batch end; each finished batch committed and its heavy files dropped from the working tree before the next starts; the coordinator stops new launches below 1 GB free

premortem.failure: The NO pool is mostly source-blocked like the one-step stratum, so producer dollars buy blocks
premortem.guard: draw NO orders at the Larrey soft level, run DISPATCH_CHECK's advisory pre-screen and HELD_SOURCES at prep, hold flagged orders, and run the Bentham gate after every batch with stop on STOP

premortem.failure: A reviewer misses a planted control or a defect slips through because review sets are pooled
premortem.guard: planted controls in every review set at the usual rate, both arms review every claim blind, a claim files only if both uphold, and any missed control stops the wave

premortem.failure: The undecided probe spends without yield, as the Lind stage-0 did (0 of 30)
premortem.guard: undecided orders run in 30-order batches after the first YES batches; the coordinator stops the stratum after any two batches that file nothing (F-20261110-mommsen3-undecided-probe01) and runs the Bentham gate after each batch

premortem.failure: Packets go stale mid-wave (the Bracton sparse-checkout defect)
premortem.guard: prepare only from the full data checkout with every jobs folder present; merges to main that change claim-kit inputs wait until a batch's completion is done

acknowledged_findings.F-20261118-kiaer-stopped-at-review: Every guard is something the coordinator runs from committed tools: prep.sh and kit.py prepare (dispatch check, HELD_SOURCES, advisory pre-screen), kit apply and batch-check, review_prep.py, finish_pair.py, adopt_replacement.py, gzip_receipts.py and the Bentham gate; the budget is sized from Bracton and trial measures (about 5 USD per filed claim).
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-papinian-undecided-u23: Undecided producers get the YES route's current-law and later-event checklist (route_undecided.txt plus the producer brief's pitfalls list, which covers U.S. Code notes and later amendments).
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-papinian-undecided-u01b: The claim kit was rebuilt on main today (run 45614623733) with current status_overlay code; the first undecided batch prepares one order first and stops on any refusal; statuses go to owner adoption.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen3-undecided-probe01: Status proposals stay isolated for owner adoption; claims file only with first end, scope, savings and current predicate proved and both arms upholding; the stratum stops after two zero-file batches.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen3-codex-core-sandbox: No Windows or Codex producers: Sonnet producers run in this cloud session on Linux with full file tools.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen-unranked-pools: Only Bentham-ranked actions; the NO stratum, below the per-dollar floor, runs as a one-lane 30-order probe; claim-kit admission refuses orders outside the named action; the Bentham gate runs after every batch.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261107-haloander-undecided-probe: The undecided rate is now measured from Bartolus u01 (4 adopted of 30) and Lind stage 0 (0 of 30); this wave adds measured batches and stops after two zero-file batches.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261028-4: Every packet is prepared fresh from the claim kit rebuilt on main today.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261018-7: Producers fetch no new hosts; they work only from held texts, and the forecast uses Bentham's measured rates.
